podcast.body: Released in 1989, this song from the album *Cloudland* was a significant moment for Pere Ubu, bringing them close to having a genuine hit on alternative radio. "pair Ubu never ascended above cult status, but they came close to having a genuine alternative radio hit in 1989, with this song from an album called, Cloudland."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song from the 1989 album *Cloudland* brought Pere Ubu close to having a genuine alternative radio hit. It features Dave Thomas's distinctive high-pitched voice. The band, including Thomas, continues to be a cult favorite. "It's called Waiting for Mary."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
